zh-HK: MTD／NB／季度／年度新增「按 Sales Area 分拆」，可逐個 Sales 對數（Sold-to 口徑），並可填每人當月 Target
分拆表可撳入睇 Sold-to 明細：當月展開 Ship-to，季度／年度展開月份；明細已計入 E-coupon Restore
新增跨 Sales Area 提醒：同一集團嘅 Sold-to 分屬唔同 Sales 時會標示（只作提示，唔影響數字）
Account adjustment 修正：金額跟 Sales Data 自動計並鎖定、每個 KPI 月份各自儲存、轉 KPI 日期後即時重算、「加入 NB」會一齊加 NB Sales
如舊版本曾經轉過 KPI 日期，請逐個月檢查 Account adjustment 有冇多咗複製嘅規則
大報價單（200 行以上）打字同捲動更順；用 Tab 由輸入格跳到按鈕後，畫面唔會再持續變慢
匯入多行產品時價錢提示計算更快；外觀、運算同匯出結果不變
匯入多行產品快好多：報價行嘅分類下拉平時只保留已選項目，撳落去先載入完整清單（平板除外）
報價行新增「過去單價」提示：上載 Sales History 並揀咗客戶後，輸入 item code、撳入或修改單價／數量時，如果客戶以前訂過，會顯示過去單價同最近 5 次訂單，一撳就套用
產品資料庫更新至 10 月（5,333 項），存貨資料更新至 2026-10-09
新版本提示同產品資料庫月份改為以 GitHub 為準，發佈後會更快收到更新提示
en: New 'By Sales Area' split under the MTD, NB, quarter and year cards (Sold-to based), with optional per-person monthly targets
Drill into each Sales Area to see its Sold-to list: Ship-tos for the month, months for the quarter / year; restored E-coupons are included
New cross Sales Area reminder when Sold-tos of one group sit under different sales reps (display only, numbers unchanged)
Account adjustment fixes: amounts follow the Sales Data and are locked, rows are saved per KPI month, MTD recalculates right after a KPI date change, and 'Add (NB)' now also adds NB Sales
If you changed the KPI date in an earlier version, check each month for duplicated Account adjustment rows
Large quotations (200+ rows) type and scroll more smoothly, and tabbing from an input onto a button no longer leaves the page running slowly
Price hints are computed faster when many rows are imported; no change to appearance, calculations or exported files
Importing many rows is much faster: each row's category dropdown now keeps only the selected item and loads the full list when opened (tablets excepted)
Quotation rows now show the customer's past unit price and last 5 orders (from Sales History) when you enter an item code or edit price / qty, with one-click apply
Product database updated to October (5,333 items); stock data updated to 2026-10-09
Update banner and product database month now follow GitHub first, so new releases are noticed sooner
